There was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] on [[Telos IV]] some decades before the [[Rise of the Empire era|rise of the empire]], he was a contact working with the failed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Dairoki]].

==Biography==
His mission was to create confusion among the people of [[Telos IV]] by making them believe that the Antarian Rangers were involved with the death of one of Telos IV priest, [[Liora]], who was actually killed by [[Dairoki]] himself, the murder was all just a plan to erupt a civil war on Telos IV ordered by Telos IV's ruler himself, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Crion]]. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were sent to investigate the murder, the Ranger was ordered to sabotage [[Mission to Telos (53 BBY)|their mission]], he and a couple of insurgents destroyed the vehicle of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tahl]], They confronted her but were defeated, only the ranger was able to escape, thanks to his training, this led Tahl to believe that the Rangers were indeed involved with the recent events, the next day he changed to civilian clothes to go unnoticed and informed Dairoki of the situation claiming that he never actually fought a Jedi before, Dairoki recommended using his Ranger uniform to which he neglected, then Dairoki told him about his next objective, and gave him a [[lightsaber]] the mission was to introduce the lightsaber in some skirmish between the Telos police and the insurgents so it would be found to make the conspiracy of the Rangers and the Jedi being involved in the revolution gain more strength. While the mission was successful, Dairoki didn't know that the insurgents were going to be hitting the royal palace, which resulted in the death of [[Nason]], Crion's Daughter and Dairoki's lover, this caused Dairoki not only grief, but also a loss in credibility to his benefactor, Crion, when Dairoki explained the situation about the lightsaber to Crion, the lord replied that it would be useless if someone had seen him during the raid on the palace, Dairoki suggested that the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] made another appearance, but Crion said that since Tahl, who was the only person that could actually identify the Ranger, was called away by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], that the Ranger could just disappear and ordered Dairoki to get offworld, one way or another.

==Powers and abilities==
While not at the same level of power of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the Antarian Ranger showed being capable of withstanding against and escape one like [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Tahl]] back when she wasn't blind, he was also trusted enough by [[Dairoki]] to carry out important missions, like sneaking a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in one skirmish, being able to survive and escape, he was usually mostly successful in his objectives and was shown to be a good [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] when he escaped Tahl with a [[Speeder/Legends|vehicle]] in a street with many obstacles.

==Equipment==
The ranger was equipped with a variety of weapons and tools such as a couple of [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol|blaster pistols]] a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] his Ranger uniform and a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] which he seemed skilled in throwing. He also got possession of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] given to him by [[Dairoki]], though he didn't get to use the weapon since his mission was just to sneak it into an skirmish.

==Behind the scenes==
The Antarian Ranger appeared in [[2011]] in [[Jedi — The Dark Side 2|''Jedi—The Dark Side'' 2]] the second of 5 issues of the [[Star Wars: Jedi — The Dark Side|Jedi The dark side]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series which was designed as a prequel to the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|Jedi Apprentice]] novel series of [[Jude Watson]]. The issue was written by [[Scott Allie]] and illustrated by [[Mahmud Asrar]].
